experiments.name: narrow
experiments.hypothesis: Explicit u16 first index prevents derived-pointer common subexpression across calls.

experiments.name: natural-spill
experiments.hypothesis: Counters may be normal register-pressure spills, which are allocated above Vec3 objects.

experiments.name: count-late
experiments.hypothesis: Retail descriptor field scheduling may follow pointer setup before counter load.

experiments.name: ordered-function-locals
experiments.hypothesis: Reverse declaration order matches observed descending nonvolatile register assignments: end, first, second, third, found, current.

result: The redundant u16 cast on the first index blocks incorrect pointer commoning. Ordinary counters then spill naturally at retail stack offsets. Function-scope integer declarations in end/first_index/second_index/third_index/found/current order reproduce nonvolatile register assignments. Canonical GC/1.3 settings unchanged.
